rationale: C11 is the directive that originally established the Federal Council on Aging which the child expressly reconstitutes and strengthens. The child retains and expands C11's concrete machinery: an interagency council addressing aging, continued responsibility in the individual agencies, coordinated review of existing programs, recommendations to agencies, agency-supplied support, and periodic reporting. C21 and C05 offer some parallel interagency-committee language and functions, but neither approaches C11's direct institutional and textual continuity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the present Federal Council on Aging, established by Presidential [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], should be strengthened... Accordingly, I am hereby reconstituting the Federal Council on Aging at Cabinet level.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I desire to establish on a broader and more permanent basis the present Interdepartmental Working Group on Aging... designate a representative from your own Department or Agency... as a Federal Council on Aging.
shared_material.explanation: The child explicitly reconstitutes the very council created by C11, changing its level and membership while preserving its institutional identity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Federal departments and agencies in their respective areas will continue to carry out their individual statutory responsibilities in the field of aging, cooperating with one another through the Council where appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: They must continue to carry on their basic responsibilities... there is a further need for coordinated policy development, planning and programming so that the departments and agencies can work together toward common objectives
shared_material.explanation: Both directives preserve agency-level responsibility while using the Council as the coordinating mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Council is directed to initiate promptly and carry on continuing reviews of Federal programs for the aging and make recommendations to me and to the interested departments and agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It will be the function of the Council to review existing programs in the light of emerging needs, and make recommendations to the appropriate departments and agencies
shared_material.explanation: This is substantially the same core operative assignment, with the child adding presidential recommendations, continuity, and an initial deadline.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shall look forward to receiving from you as Chairman periodic reports on the progress and recommendations of the Council.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Council will make its own arrangements as to Chairmanship, meetings, procedures, enlarging membership, and appropriate periodic reports.
shared_material.explanation: The periodic-reporting mechanism is carried forward and made the chairman's express responsibility.
